svg.text: ECS Fargate + Fargate Spot Capacity Provider Strategy with AZ Rebalancing
One service mixes FARGATE (base) and FARGATE_SPOT (weighted), spreads tasks over three AZs, and drains on SIGTERM
1 in dev (1 per AZ in prd)
strategy: FARGATE base 2, weight 1 / FARGATE_SPOT weight 3
round robin to healthy targets in every AZ
places tasks: strategy + AZ spread, rebalances AZs
